items.title: Federico Stefanovich revamps studio in 1920s Mexico City building to showcase his lighting
items.summary: Lighting designer Federico Stefanovich has renovated his studio in a 1920s Mexico City building to display his own expressive metal luminaires.

items.title: Pharos powers heritage facade lighting at Parliament of Victoria
items.summary: A Pharos control platform replaces an ageing sodium vapour floodlighting scheme on the heritage facade of Victoria's Parliament building, enabling finer control and a more considered reveal of the historic architecture.
